page.overview:
What is Marlin Coast?

Marlin Coast is a small abandoned settlement located on the northern shores of Undvik. It was later used as a makeshift camp by the Nilfgaardian Empire during their attack on Skellige.

Until quite recently this beach was frequented by fishermen come to fish marlins out of the nearby waters.
